lines.text: Added new top level export Console
Console.SetConvar is not restricted by sv_cheats and executes synchronously
Moved Instance.ClientCommand, ServerCommand and RegisterCheatCommand to Console
Added new top level export GameRules
Moved Instance.IsWarmupPeriod, IsFreezePeriod, IsTeamIntroPeriod, GetRoundsPlayed, GetRoundRemainingTime, SetRoundRemainingTime and AddTeamMoney to GameRules
Moved and renamed methods are still available in their original location, deprecated
Added top-level custom_hud_layout classes HUD_TEAMMENU_VISIBLE and HUD_CHAT_VISIBLE
radar_element can now appear on the radar in every game mode, not just Rush
Added support for GameRules.AddTeamMoney with CSTeamMoneyReason.NONE and an amount
Fixed a crash in GameRules.AddTeamMoney with CSTeamMoneyReason.NONE
Fixed CSTeamMoneyReason enum values not matching point_script.d.ts
Fixed CSWeaponAttackType enum values not matching point_script.d.ts
Fixed CSRadarPoint.IsVisibleToTeam returning a number instead of a boolean
Fixed CSObservablePoint.IsObservableForTeam returning a number instead of a boolean
Logged warnings now include the JS call stack
Logged warnings now include details about bad argument values
Logged warnings now count arguments from 0 instead of 1
Improved auto complete of the map_workshop command
